newsitem.title: USA: Liz Claiborne acquires JH Collectibles.
newsitem.headline: Liz Claiborne acquires JH Collectibles.

text.p: Liz Claiborne Inc said it has acquired JH Collectibles trademarks and the leasehold interests in an outlet store in Harriman, New York.
The company said JH Collectibles was in liquidation under bankruptcy laws.
"Taking advantage of an opportunity to acquire a high quality name like JH Collectibles is consistent with our branded portfolio strategy," said Liz Claiborne chairman Paul Charron.

"Our research indicates that JH Collectibles' high favorability ratings among consumers will give us broad latitude in leveraging the brand to address needs in the market. Over time, we will evaluate the most appropriate use for this great brand name," Charron said.
